subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 6: Review + Sounds review s, a, t, p, n
outcomes: I can say all the Unit 1 family and friends words.
I can ask Who's this? and What's your name? and answer.
I can read and write tap, pat, nap and pan.

tf.s: Mum, dad, brother and sister are family words.
tf.why: Yes! They are all in the family.

tf.s: Cat is a family word like mum.
tf.why: A cat is an animal, not a person.

tf.s: Tin and teddy start with the same sound.
We answer Who's this? with This is my brother.
tf.why: Yes! This is my … tells who it is.

tf.s: Net starts with the letter t.

boxes.q: Who's this? (a girl in your family)
boxes.why: A girl in your family is your sister.

boxes.q: You can say all the words. Colour the …
boxes.why: A happy face means: I can do it!

hunt.q: Catch the word that is not family.

mcq.q: Which word is NOT a family word?
mcq.why: A friend is not in your family.

mcq.q: Which question asks for a name?
mcq.why: What's your name? asks for a name.

mcq.q: Which sounds did we learn in Unit 1?
mcq.why: Unit 1 sounds are s, a, t, p, n.

mcq.q: You show a drawing of your dad. You say …
Write the word: t – a – p
Put the letters in order to make a word: a, n, p
Which two words start with the same sound?
mcq.why: Tin and teddy both start with /t/.

mcq.q: Which word does not belong: tap, pat, nap, mum?
mcq.why: Mum is a family word; tap, pat and nap are blending words.

mcq.q: Sami says: This is my brother. Who is it?
